# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Anker Soundcore Space One (about $100, about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products' top pick under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a comfortable rotating-cup fit, a strong companion app with EQ, and 55 hours of battery. It's a bit heavy. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- Soundcore's official store lists it at $99.99. The code AFSC20 took it to $80 in a cart test on Oct 22, 2026, but it's not valid on sale items, so check at checkout. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one) (an affiliate link that pays Dealectric a commission at no cost to you).

**Best noise cancelling: Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (about $100)**
- RTINGS calls it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested. It quiets engine rumble and office chatter well. Battery is about 28 hours, and some owners report the headband cracking, so handle it gently. [RTINGS review list](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- One retailer guide claims 50 hours and LDAC, which conflicts with RTINGS's tested figure. I'd trust RTINGS.

**Best cheaper option: Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024)**
- It nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation for less money, with a 49-hour battery. It's weaker on bass rumble, and the plastic build creaks. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Other good picks**
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS's top over-ear under $100, with about 44 hours of battery and good engine and chatter blocking. It leaks sound, though. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Sony WH-CH720N (about $99):** very light at 192g and good against HVAC hum, but it has no LDAC. This comes from a retailer guide, so treat the ratings with caution. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** the best-value pick. Best Products says it has 45 hours of battery and hybrid ANC. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (about $79):** a bass-heavy sound and the best call mic of the under-$100 group, but weaker ANC. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** the most durable budget pair, with stainless-steel hinges, though its noise isolation is weaker. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**My suggestion:** get the Space One if you want the best all-rounder, especially at $80 with the code. Get the Q45 if noise blocking matters most, or the Edifier Atom Max if you want to spend the least.

I only have the Space One's direct purchase link. For the others, the RTINGS and Best Products pages above have retailer links, and prices vary by store.
